name: High IQ
caption: A Lost Circle-affiliated brother tag team managed by Isabeau, beaten in their WWFL debut by the Loose Cannons and again in a title-eliminator cage match at Spring Breakout '98.

tenures.source: The fed's own 19 February 1998 broadcast ("WWFL Tuesday Night Torture"). The fed's own 27 April 1998 pay-per-view ("WWFL Spring Breakout '98").

name: The Loose Cannons
caption: A tag team feuding with High IQ across the WWFL's spring 1998 record, winning both of their meetings.

tenures.source: The fed's own 19 February 1998 broadcast ("WWFL Tuesday Night Torture"). The fed's own 27 April 1998 pay-per-view ("WWFL Spring Breakout '98").

name: The Freedom Fighters
caption: A Phoenix-billed tag team who won the WWFL Tag Team Championship from the All Americans on 19 February 1998.

tenures.source: The fed's own 19 February 1998 broadcast ("WWFL Tuesday Night Torture").

name: The All Americans
caption: A Detroit-billed tag team managed by "Beautiful" Sally Short, dethroned as WWFL Tag Team Champions by the Freedom Fighters on 19 February 1998.

tenures.source: The fed's own 19 February 1998 broadcast ("WWFL Tuesday Night Torture").

identity.note: A different persona of the same name is recorded elsewhere in the held record's other federations; nothing in this wing's own served record links the two.
